page: Microsoft Azure DC16ads_v6 is an x86_64 virtual machine instance belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core.
This server configuration includes 614 GB of local disk storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio provide a stable resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads. The inclusion of local storage and Premium Storage compatibility makes this instance appropriate for database hosting, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications that require dedicated compute resources without GPU acceleration.
